ra: Tawusi Melek is the chief of the Seven Mysteries/Heptad (Spat, Kreyenbroek).
Sheikh Adi is counted among the manifestations of the Heptad in the qewls (Kreyenbroek).
Sheikh Hasan (Sheikh Sin) is one of the Seven Mysteries (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).
Sheikh Shams is one of the Seven, associated with the sun (Spat, Kreyenbroek).
Sheikh Fakhr al-Din is one of the Seven Mysteries (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).
Sheikh Sajadin is enumerated among the Seven Mysteries in the qewls (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).
Sheikh Nasirdin is enumerated among the Seven Mysteries in the qewls (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).
Sheikh Obekr appears among the Seven in several enumerations of the Heptad (Kreyenbroek).
Xwede, the remote creator, brings forth and delegates the world to the Heptad (Kreyenbroek).
Tawusi Melek is the foremost emanation/vicegerent of Xwede (Spat, Kreyenbroek).
The Heptad and especially Sheikh Adi govern the sanctified realm of Lalish in Yazidi cosmology (Spat).
Sheikh Adi's tomb is at Lalish, the supreme pilgrimage center (Spat, Kreyenbroek).
Pir Libnan is associated in the qewls with the sacred building of Lalish (Kreyenbroek).
Sultan Ezid is a divine manifestation closely woven into the Heptad theology of the qewls (Spat, Kreyenbroek).
Pir Mehma Reshan figures among the holy pir lineages tied to the Heptad's earthly manifestations (Omarkhali, Kreyenbroek).
Khatuna Fakhra is a revered woman of the Adani holy circle in Yazidi devotion (Spat).
Sheikh Adi ibn Musafir was a historical Sufi ascetic of the Qadiri-adjacent Baghdad milieu of Abd al-Qadir al-Jilani; Yazidism received him as a supreme manifestation (Kreyenbroek).
The Yazidi exaltation of the foremost angel echoes the Sufi (Hallajian) defense of Iblis's refusal to bow as supreme love/obedience to God alone; a theological parallel, not an identification (Spat).
Yazidis explicitly reject the external conflation of Tawusi Melek with Shaytan/the devil; modeled here to record that the misidentification is repudiated, not affirmed (Spat, Kreyenbroek).
Sheikh Shams embodies solar veneration in Yazidism, functionally parallel to the sun-spirit of astral/planetary traditions (Kreyenbroek); cognate alignment, not identity.
